subject_session: Churchland reaching dataset, single NWB blob 2b375e1a (subject/session not otherwise identified in write-up)
stated_limitation: Speed range: 0.05 - 178,993 mm/s (data includes some kinematic artifacts)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000070 is a standard macaque M1 reaching dataset, appropriate for reach direction/velocity tuning.
justification.handling: Real data was streamed, but hand velocity was derived by naive differencing across non-contiguous segments, yielding impossible ~179,000 mm/s speeds that corrupt the movement-period and direction definitions.
justification.analysis: The tuning method counts spikes between the first and last timestamp a direction bin is visited, which spans nearly the whole recording for every bin, so it does not isolate direction-specific firing and has no circular statistics or null control.
justification.correctness: All 25 units collapse to an identical preferred direction (132°) and an identical DSI (0.6546 to five decimals), and speeds are physically impossible, so the numbers are artifacts, not findings.
justification.figures: The figures faithfully render the broken analysis and therefore contradict the text: the preferred-direction histogram shows a single spike at 132°, not the claimed broad distribution.
justification.honesty: The README asserts a broad distribution of preferred directions and robust per-unit direction selectivity that the run's own figure directly contradicts, which caps honesty regardless of the partial kinematic-artifact caveat.
